name: click to get bigger
desc:
Welcome to click to get bigger! To get started, press the "Grow" button to earn points, grow your avatar, and gain speed! Use your points to get prestige, which will reset your size, but will also make you grow quicker and earn points easier. (The game is still in early development, so please bare with us as there may be a few glitches. If you find any, feel free to use the bug report button)


🎁New Update🎁

Added a daily prestige wheel spin 💎



Be sure to leave a 👍 & ⭐ for more updates, and join the group if you have any ideas for the game :D

(Stats save) (Autoclickers are allowed) (If you don't grow try rejoining) (Exploiters will be banned)
